Setbacks
C1. All buildings, including basements, must
provide a minimum 6 metre setback from
Marco Avenue for all buildings to maintain
a consistent landscaped frontage that and
retain existing trees.

must be visually broken up using a

following
a. Changes in building mass
b. Recessed sections
c. Different materials
d. Window placement and design
C3. Buildings at the western corner must
have visible entrances, windows, or
architectural features.
C4. Building facades must incorporate high-
quality, durable materials that contribute
to a cohesive and attractive streetscape.
